Docs.summary: External Auth claim profile This configures how the groups of a cluster identity should be constructed from the claims in a JWT token issued by the identity provider. When referencing a claim, if the claim is present in the JWT token, its value must be a list of groups separated by a comma (','). For example - '"example"' and '"exampleOne", "exampleTwo", "exampleThree"' are valid claim values.
